title: Phase 91 adds finance, banking, credit, capital-allocation, monetary-system, and financial-stability controls
summary: Eight inactive money and banking dossiers, eight credit ledgers, eight capital-market and insurance registers, and eight monetary-policy and financial-stability ledgers expose the complete financial-system contract without classifying money, admitting accounts, extending credit, allocating capital, valuing assets, deciding insurance claims, intervening, guaranteeing, resolving, assigning losses, scoring, ranking, or deciding for a borrower, saver, investor, beneficiary, policyholder, institution, community, or jurisdiction.
evidence_note: This release contains empty money, payment, banking-access, settlement, credit, underwriting, affordability, servicing, allocation, capital-market, valuation, investment, insurance, monetary-policy, systemic-risk, guarantee, resolution and public-value contracts plus synthetic-only validation. It contains no verified Phase 90 predecessor or Phase 91 decision or receipt.
publication_effect: Adds twelve Published briefings, six Published maps, one searchable registry with thirty-two detail routes, one public export, and reader-surface integrations while leaving all evidence, market-governance, financial and operating states unchanged.
